newsitem.title: USA: Westell not uncomfortable with estimates.
newsitem.headline: Westell not uncomfortable with estimates.

text.p: Westell Technologies Inc said Thursday it is not uncomfortable with analysts' estimates for a loss of $0.04 a share for its fiscal second quarter ended September 30.
According to First Call, analysts' consensus estimate is a loss of $0.04 a share for the quarter versus a loss of $0.02 last year.
"We're not uncomfortable with the analysts' expectations that are out there," said Gary Seamans, chairman and chief executive of Westell.
He said the loss is directly related to research and development expenses, of which about 75 percent go toward its digital subscriber line technology for high-speed Internet access.
"What we're doing here is deferred profit. We would be foolish not to take the investment steps necessary...that's why you see that minor worsening," he said.
The company said it will likely report results during the week of October 21.
